goal:
T29 — X_SINGLE cost from provider usage, and a reason for every task score (board W4 + W9).

Today services/api/evoforge/sealed_eval.py::_call_builder_task reserves BASELINE_COST_CENTS (120c) and always settles 120c,
so the production X_SINGLE cost (1440c for 12 tasks) is a constant while PIPELINE settles provider usage
(performance.usage_cost_cents). Cost-per-solved is therefore not comparable. And eval scores carry only `score`, so a low
number cannot be split into model vs harness vs spec causes (the 2026-10-28 diagnosis had to be done by hand).

1. Baseline settles from usage exactly like the pipeline attempts: actual = performance.usage_cost_cents(
   performance.usage_from_output(out)); when usage is missing settle at BASELINE_COST_CENTS and mark the measurement
   usage_missing=True (record and /v1/performance view). Usage above the reservation is settled at its real value (the
   ledger already records an overrun) — never capped or hidden. Measurement cost_cents = sum of settled amounts.
   Refund/unknown handling for provider errors stays as today.
2. Every entry in `scores` (baseline and pipeline, sync and job paths, and the stored evidence) gets
   "outcome": one of "passed" | "empty_diff" | "apply_failed" | "heldout_failed", and "failing_tests": a list of failing
   held-out test function names (only for heldout_failed; [] otherwise). Names only — never held-out code, assertion
   text or reference fixes. For the pipeline, the outcome is that of the task's final attempt.
3. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t29.py. Keep every existing test green; do not change patch.py or main.py
   request models.
